# Not Jam Music Pack

The music in this directory was created by NotJam.

Source:
https://not-jam.itch.io/not-jam-music-pack

License:
CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The assets in this directory are distributed under CC0 and are not subject to
the repository's Apache-2.0 license.

The loopable source tracks were converted from Ogg Vorbis to 128 kbps Ogg Opus
before being imported into Unity. Masonry's editor importer decodes these Opus
sources into Unity AudioClips so Unity can package them for desktop and web.
